new_moon.name: New moon
new_moon.line: The sky goes dark and quiet
new_moon.reading: Nothing to see, everything to begin. This is the dark before a seed decides to grow, a good night to name one thing and plant it small

waxing_crescent.name: Waxing crescent
waxing_crescent.reading: The first sliver asks for a first step. Keep what you named close and give it one small act today

first_quarter.name: First quarter
first_quarter.reading: Halfway up, the moon meets resistance, and so may you. A good moment to adjust, not to give up

waxing_gibbous.name: Waxing gibbous
waxing_gibbous.reading: The light is gathering. Tend what is growing, patiently, the way you water a plant you can't yet see flower

full_moon.name: Full moon
full_moon.reading: Everything is visible now, the beautiful and the unfinished. Look, give thanks, and let yourself be seen

waning_gibbous.name: Waning gibbous
waning_gibbous.reading: After the fullness comes the sharing. Pass on what you learned, thank who walked with you

last_quarter.name: Last quarter
last_quarter.reading: A moment to sort and release. Keep what is true, set down what no longer fits

waning_crescent.name: Waning crescent
waning_crescent.reading: The cycle is resting before it begins again. Sleep a little more, ask a little less, make room

aries.name: Aries
aries.new: The new moon in Aries is the zodiac's first breath. A good night to begin the thing you keep postponing, small and brave rather than perfect
aries.full: The full moon lights Aries across from Libra. See where you have been fighting alone, and what your courage has already made possible

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.new: The new moon in Taurus asks for something slow. Plant a habit, a saving, a kinder way of caring for your body, and let it take its time
taurus.full: The full moon lights Taurus across from Scorpio. Harvest what you built with patience, and notice what you are holding too tightly

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.new: The new moon in Gemini loves words. Say your intention out loud, begin a study, write the letter you keep drafting in your head
gemini.full: The full moon lights Gemini across from Sagittarius. Listen for what has been said and what has not, and choose the words you want to keep

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.new: The new moon in Cancer turns toward home. Make room for care: your space, your people, the child you once were
cancer.full: The full moon lights Cancer, the moon's own sign, across from Capricorn. Feel what home means to you now, and thank those who hold you

leo.name: Leo
leo.new: The new moon in Leo speaks to the heart. Begin something that makes you glad to be yourself, even if no one sees it yet
leo.full: The full moon lights Leo across from Aquarius. Let yourself be seen in what you made, and celebrate it without shrinking

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.new: The new moon in Virgo is about daily care. Choose one simple gesture for your body or your days and keep it gently
virgo.full: The full moon lights Virgo across from Pisces. See which routines feed you and which only tire you

libra.name: Libra
libra.new: The new moon in Libra seeks balance. Begin a new agreement, with someone you love or with yourself
libra.full: The full moon lights Libra across from Aries. Notice where you give more than you receive, and where you receive without noticing

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.new: The new moon in Scorpio goes deep. Sow trust by opening one door you usually keep closed
scorpio.full: The full moon lights Scorpio across from Taurus. Let go of what has already ended, and keep what is true

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.new: The new moon in Sagittarius looks far. Ask a bigger question and take the first step toward it
sagittarius.full: The full moon lights Sagittarius across from Gemini. See how far you have come, and what you believe now

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.new: The new moon in Capricorn builds. Lay the first stone of a long goal, one you are willing to walk slowly
capricorn.full: The full moon lights Capricorn across from Cancer. Recognize your effort, and set down a weight that was never yours

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.new: The new moon in Aquarius thinks of others. Sow a hope that has room for more people than you
aquarius.full: The full moon lights Aquarius across from Leo. See who walks with you, and where you want to be free

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.new: The new moon in Pisces begins in silence. A dream, a prayer, a softer way of meeting the day
pisces.full: The full moon lights Pisces across from Virgo. Feel what is dissolving now, and trust what remains

houses.1: In your 1st house, it falls on you: your body, your presence, the way you begin
houses.2: In your 2nd house, it falls on what you value: your resources, your money, what feels like enough
houses.3: In your 3rd house, it falls on your words: what you learn, the people close by, your daily paths
houses.4: In your 4th house, it falls on your roots: home, family, the ground you stand on
houses.5: In your 5th house, it falls on your joy: love, creativity, what makes you play
houses.6: In your 6th house, it falls on your days: the small habits that care for you
houses.7: In your 7th house, it falls on your bonds: partners, love, the agreements you share
houses.8: In your 8th house, it falls on what is shared and what is ready to change and be let go
houses.9: In your 9th house, it falls on meaning: faith, study, the places you long to go
houses.10: In your 10th house, it falls on your work: your purpose and how the world meets you
houses.11: In your 11th house, it falls on your people: friends, community, the hopes you hold together
houses.12: In your 12th house, it falls on rest: solitude, retreat, what grows unseen

solar_eclipse.name: Solar eclipse
solar_eclipse.line: A new moon that covers the sun. Many traditions met it with stillness rather than action, so this is a night to notice, not to force

lunar_eclipse.name: Lunar eclipse
lunar_eclipse.line: A full moon that passes through Earth's shadow and often turns copper. A night to watch, rest, and let something close on its own

supermoon.name: Supermoon
supermoon.line: The moon is near its closest to Earth, so it looks a little larger and brighter. The same moon, simply nearer

micromoon.name: Micromoon
micromoon.line: The moon is near its farthest from Earth, a little smaller in the sky. A quieter fullness

blue_moon.name: Blue moon
blue_moon.line: The second full moon in one calendar month. Rare enough to name, a second chance at the same harvest

black_moon.name: Black moon
black_moon.line: The second new moon in one calendar month. A second dark, a second beginning

origin.text: Reading the moon by sign is old. Babylonian astronomers divided the sky into twelve equal signs around the fifth century BCE¹, and Hellenistic astrologers read each sign as a whole house of life, counting from the sign rising at birth². India keeps a kindred practice in its 27 lunar mansions, the nakshatras, and China in its 28 lodges, where the moon rests one night at a time³

tone: Light only. The moon does nothing by itself: a phase is a moment, the sign a tone, the house an area of life. Never predict, never promise. No final period, by design
